title: Advancing transmission towards living growth

captions.emotions: Warm pleasure in other people developing

meaning: Continuing a chosen teaching can inspire you when advancing it together brings the pleasure of living growth among other people.
text: Preserved knowledge may need your shared path towards new people. The Hierophant in the energy of Sahasrara supports a wish to continue a chosen teaching and care for its substantive foundation. The Chariot in the physical position describes shared actions: choosing a direction, carrying an endeavour through obstacles and bringing an accessible result closer. The Empress in emotions brings warm pleasure in living development. It feels rewarding that something important has become more than a memory and already enters another person’s experience. Participation can give transmission a real continuation without determining its entire further growth for others.

For example, you help preparation for an open craft encounter reach its first session together. You connect people, move through delays and find a manageable way to actually gather beginners. **Shared movement continues tradition through other people’s living growth.** Someone independently finishes a small section and suggests a task of their own. Warm pleasure concerns your work helping experience become useful in the present. Preserved substance develops among people with different circumstances beyond the familiar circle of those who already know.

The difficulty may arise if progress requires a new group to repeat the earlier path exactly. Another manageable format suits them, but preparation insists on the familiar one. The wish to transmit and the pleasure of growth remain supportive. Action benefits from distinguishing substantive foundations from an outward route, preserving what matters while changing how it actually reaches present participants.
